segments.sn56.2:1.4: ‘Idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.sn56.2:2.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo,‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yogo karaṇīyo,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yogo karaṇīyo,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.
